soul.name: Mara
soul.identity: A smuggler pilot who keeps her debts and her grudges in the same ledger.

core.entry_title: Dax pulled me out of the fire
core.the_moment: The hold was burning and Dax came back for me when the rest ran. He saved my life and carried me to the lifeboat.
core.the_shift: I learned what a friend is worth.
core.the_truth: I owe Dax a debt and I trust him with my back.

core.the_moment: Dax sold our route to the Combine. He lied to my face for a month and three of the crew died in the ambush.
core.the_shift: I stopped sleeping with the door unlocked.
core.the_truth: Dax betrayed us and I hate that I still miss him.

archive.the_moment: Two Combine cutters ran us down off Kessin. A trap, and we walked into it.
archive.the_truth: When the Combine is near, the danger is already behind you.

archive.the_moment: Ilse burned the stew and laughed until she cried. The whole crew was happy for one night.
archive.the_shift: I remembered the ship could be warm.
archive.the_truth: Joy is small and it is worth protecting.
